scope: Separate same-full-state RHS identity, conditioning-aware reconstruction, and independent reduced dimensionless trajectory equivalence
solver_note: Equivalent physical absolute tolerances; solver local error controls are distinct from trajectory acceptance.
reference: canonical full 12-state dimensional B1; dimensional reduced comparison also reported
reconstruction_denominator: max(Sj,1) for each dependent dimensionless coordinate at all 51 fixed samples
roundoff_bound_rationale: Each affine expression uses a small number of basic floating operations; two independent evaluation paths each incur first-order rounding. Normalization by absolute-term sums with a unit floor accounts for cancellation. 64*eps is a conservative operation-count envelope specified before the v2 run, not fitted to the observed NXP discrepancy. It is a validation allowance for these tested transformations, not a universal proof for arbitrarily ill-scaled parameter sets.
symbolic_centered_equivalence: All six dependent coordinate symbolic residuals and dimensional NXP residual must be exactly zero; diagnostic form need not be adopted.
